001package org.clafer.math;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006/**
007 *
008 * @author jimmy
009 */
010public class LinearFunctionBuilder implements LinearFunctionable {
011
012    private final List<Rational> coefficients = new ArrayList<>();
013    private final List<Variable> variables = new ArrayList<>();
014    private Rational constant = Rational.Zero;
015
016    public static LinearFunctionBuilder term(Variable variable) {
017        return term(Rational.One, variable);
018    }
019
020    public static LinearFunctionBuilder term(Rational coefficient, Variable variable) {
021        return new LinearFunctionBuilder().plusTerm(coefficient, variable);
022    }
023
024    public static LinearFunctionBuilder constant(long c) {
025        return constant(new Rational(c));
026    }
027
028    public static LinearFunctionBuilder constant(Rational c) {
029        return new LinearFunctionBuilder().plusConstant(c);
030    }
031
032    public static LinearFunctionBuilder function(LinearFunction function) {
033        return new LinearFunctionBuilder().plusFunction(function);
034    }
035
036    public LinearFunctionBuilder plusTerm(Variable variable) {
037        return plusTerm(Rational.One, variable);
038    }
039
040    public LinearFunctionBuilder plusTerm(Rational coefficient, Variable variable) {
041        coefficients.add(coefficient);
042        variables.add(variable);
043        return this;
044    }
045
046    public LinearFunctionBuilder plusConstant(long constant) {
047        this.constant = this.constant.add(constant);
048        return this;
049    }
050
051    public LinearFunctionBuilder plusConstant(Rational constant) {
052        this.constant = this.constant.add(constant);
053        return this;
054    }
055
056    public LinearFunctionBuilder plusFunction(LinearFunction function) {
057        Rational[] cs = function.getCoefficients();
058        Variable[] vs = function.getVariables();
059        for (int i = 0; i < cs.length; i++) {
060            plusTerm(cs[i], vs[i]);
061        }
062        plusConstant(function.getConstant());
063        return this;
064    }
065
066    @Override
067    public LinearFunction toFunction() {
068        return new LinearFunction(
069                coefficients.toArray(new Rational[coefficients.size()]),
070                variables.toArray(new Variable[variables.size()]),
071                constant);
072    }
073}
